description: Header file defining the du_ue_manager class, which manages User Equipment (UE) contexts in a Distributed Unit (DU) within a 5G network stack. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and handling UE-related requests, as well as internal data structures for managing UEs and associated resources.

classes.name: du_ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts within the DU, handling creation, update, deletion, and reconfiguration requests, and maintaining internal data structures for active UEs.

methods.name: du_ue_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE manager with configuration, resource allocation, and cell management references.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds and returns an unused UE index.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles creation of a new UE context upon UL-CCCH reception.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request (F1AP)
methods.description: Handles creation of a new UE context via F1AP request.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request (F1AP)
methods.description: Handles update of an existing UE context via F1AP request.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles removal of a UE context via F1AP request.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles DRB deactivation for a UE.

methods.name: handle_reestablishment_request
methods.description: Handles reestablishment of a UE connection.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request (RIC)
methods.description: Handles UE configuration via RIC request.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Retrieves a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of active UEs.

methods.name: get_du_ues
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal UE database.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an async task for a specific UE.

methods.name: get_f1u_teid_pool
methods.description: Provides access to the TEID pool for F1-U.
